description: This sample screen lets you choose a contact and a location-sharing option.
steps: Check the contact name at the top of the chat.
Choose a one-time current location or live location. Live location may continue sharing for a period of time.
If you choose live location, review the sharing duration shown on your screen.
Tap Send only if you want to share your location with this contact.
safety_note: Only share your location with someone you trust. Never share a password, one-time code (OTP), or PIN.

suggested_questions.question: How do I choose whether to share my location?

description: This sample compose screen shows an email with an attachment being added.
steps: Check the recipient address before adding or sending a file.
Tap the paperclip icon to open the attachment choices.
Choose a file from your device, then select the document or photo.
Wait for the file name to appear in the email and check that it is the file you intended to share.
Review the message and recipient. Tap Send only when you are ready.
safety_note: Only attach files you intend to share. Never send a password, one-time code (OTP), or PIN.

suggested_questions.question: How can I check which file I attached?
